scientific_limitations_and_integrity.established: Global recovery from the first three consecutive moments; sharp classification of nonuniqueness for the first two.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.not_established: No reconstruction claim for other convex bodies, nonuniform directions, particle mixtures, noisy data, or arbitrary two selected moments. No independent historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.provenance: Analytic proof with exact rational sign bound; reproducibility code is a consistency check and not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Exact population moments of planar orthogonal projection area for one solid right circular cylinder with arbitrary finite positive radius and height; uniform plane direction.

title: The first three random-shadow area moments reconstruct every right circular cylinder
